subject: Cave
text: Heading north out of the cave leads to Yum Yum's Cave, the first dungeon of the game.

evidence.quote: Head north out of the cave to get to Yum Yum's Cave, the first dungeon of the game.

subject: secret room
text: After killing the 4 boars and then all enemies in the next room, return to the previous room to enter the secret passage and get a medicine.

evidence.quote: Move up and kill the 4 boars, then in the next room kill all the enemies. You will hear a secret passage opening up in the previous room. Return to that room and enter the secret room to get a medicine, then go back to the latest room.

subject: three bears
text: Killing the three bears opens up a passageway to the next room.

evidence.quote: Kill the three bears to open up a passageway, then take it and head to the next room, running straight through it.

subject: shape puzzle
object: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle
text: To solve the shape puzzle and get out, choose the path shapes in order: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle.

evidence.quote: Here's the way to get out of here: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Run up to the right side of Yum Yum while he eats a boar and quickly fire axes at him to beat him before he starts his attack.

evidence.quote: He starts off eating a boar, and if you run up to the right side of him and quickly fire axes at him, you should be able to beat him before he even starts his attack!

subject: Tetrad
text: After defeating the boss, proceed to the next screen to find the Tetrad block, speak with Micah, and have your life meter increased.

evidence.quote: Proceed to the next screen, and a bunch of kids will be forever indebted to you... You'll find a weird block thing, and then Micah will contact you again... then says she thinks her father wants you to find the Tetrads... Your life meter will be increased, and Mike will chant that spell to go back in time again..

subject: queen Cleopatra
text: Board the ship and talk to everyone to reach Queen Cleopatra, who demands a pizza in exchange for information about the tetrad.

evidence.quote: Go north and go on the ship, then talk to everyone. The guard will now let you pass and talk to the queen. She knows about the tetrad, but she wants a pizza in exchange for her valuable information.

subject: chest
text: Jump on the tile and walk through the question mark orb to open the chest containing a slingshot.

evidence.quote: Jump on the tile and then walk through the question mark orb to open the chest. The chest contains a slingshot.

subject: moving tile room
text: Kill all the moving tiles to unveil the path and grab the medicine before moving to the next room.

evidence.quote: Kill all of them, and the path to the next room will be unveiled. Grab the medicine, then move onto the next room.

subject: Scorpion
text: Switch to the slingshot and fire at the large scorpion while avoiding bullets and killing little scorpions emerging from holes.

evidence.quote: He is in a large room, and little scorpions come out of the holes in the room. They are more challenging to avoid than the boss himself, who softly moves around and occasionally shoots out easily avoided bullets... Switch to the slingshot and fire away on the scorpion, avoiding and killing the little ones that get in your way.

subject: pizza delivery guy
text: Agree to give the pizza from the guy on the camel directly to Cleopatra to return to the boat.

evidence.quote: You will now meet up with a guy on the camel, who is the pizza delivery guy. Agree to give the pizza to Cleopatra directly, and you will automatically return to the boat.

subject: Cleopatra
text: Cleopatra gives you a dagger to help with the journey after receiving the pizza.

evidence.quote: Cleopatra will be pleased, and she will give you a dagger to help with the journey.

subject: Monkey Puzzle
text: From the left opening, navigate 3 left, 7 up, 2 left, 3 up, 6 right, 3 down, 6 right, 5 down, 2 right, 4 up, 2 right, 4 down, 2 right, 11 up, 2 left, and 2 up to reach a battle scene.

evidence.quote: Go to the left opening and go 3 left, 7 up, 2 left, 3 up, 6 right, 3 down, 6 right, 5 down, 2 right, 4 up, 2 right, 4 down, 2 right, 11 up, 2 left, and 2 up. Yes, I figured this out by myself over time. You'll fall into a battle scene now.

subject: Monkey Puzzle
text: Go through the left and navigate 4 left, 10 up, 7 right, 5 down, 2 right, and down to obtain a big heart container.

evidence.quote: Go through the left and go 4 left, 10 up, 7 right, 5 down, 2 right, and down to get a big heart.

subject: Monkey Puzzle
text: From the big heart, proceed 7 up, 3 left, 6 up, 6 left, 4 up, 1 left, 4 up, 4 left, 4 down, 2 left, 5 up, 5 left, and 1 down to drop into another battle scene.

evidence.quote: Then go 7 up, 3 left, 6 up, 6 left, 4 up, 1 left, 4 up, 4 left, 4 down, 2 left, 5 up, 5 left, 1 down, and you will fall into another battle scene.

subject: Monkey Puzzle
text: Navigate 4 left, 2 down, all the way left, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, all the way down, 1 left, 4 down, 11 left, 3 up, 1 left, 4 up, 5 right, 3 up, 6 left, 8 up, 3 right, 1 down, 5 right, 3 up, right around the bench, 3 right, 3 up, 3 right, and up to obtain the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: Go 4 left, 2 down, all the way left, 4 down, 3 left, 1 down, 3 left, all the way down, 1 left, 4 down, 11 left, 3 up, 1 left, 4 up, 5 right, 3 up, 6 left, 8 up, 3 right, 1 down, 5 right, 3 up, right around the bench, 3 right, 3 up, 3 right, and up! He will give you the Psychic Shockwave and leave you off in the pyramid!

subject: pyramid barrier
text: Switch to the Psychic weapon to break the barrier blocking entry to the pyramid.

evidence.quote: Now, you can break that damn barrier, so switch to the Psychic weapon and do so!

subject: platform room
text: Hit the switch on the top left tile and jump onto the platform to retrieve a medicine.

evidence.quote: Kill the mummy and mini mummy, then hit the switch in the top left tile. Jump on the platform and get the medicine, then wait for the platform to reappear, then jump across it and follow the path across.

subject: middle block
text: Hit the right tile of the middle block of tiles to get a medicine.

evidence.quote: In the next room, kill all the enemies, then hit the right tile of the middle block of tiles to get a medicine.

subject: switch
text: Kill all the mini mummies and get the Flute from the switch.

evidence.quote: In the next room, kill all the mini mummies and then get the Flute from the switch.

subject: Flute
text: Return to the snake room and use the Flute to make snakes appear; killing them opens a secret passageway.

evidence.quote: Return to that snake room and push the flute. (Pause then down and select the Flute) The snakes will come out of the room. Kill them and it opens a secret passageway.

subject: Egyptian Mask
text: Switch to the Shockwave while standing on the conveyor belt to attack the Egyptian Mask.

evidence.quote: The Egyptian Mask is a little challenging due to the conveyor belt that you have to stand on... Switch to the Shockwave and figure out its simple pattern, then start attacking it easily.

subject: Egyptian Mask
text: Defeating the Egyptian Mask raises your life meter by 1 and awards a Tetrad to complete Chapter 3.

evidence.quote: Your life meter will be raised by 1, you'll get a tetrad, and this chapter will be history!

subject: jail cell
text: Escape from the jail cell by pushing against the right hand wall to find the hidden path outside.

evidence.quote: escape from the escape route free jail cell by pushing against the right hand wall until you find the path. Follow the path outside, and follow it along to get to the museum.

subject: open manhole
text: Take the open manhole to the left of the museum to obtain a big heart container, increasing your total life by 1 heart.

evidence.quote: Take the open manhole to the left to get a big heart container, increasing your total life by 1 heart.

subject: giant rat room
text: Trigger the switch on the tile second from the top on the left side, kill the giant rats in the next room, and collect the medicine.

evidence.quote: There are monkeys on the raised areas in here, and a switch on the tile second from top on the left hand side. Take the switch first, then kill the giant rats in the next room (just hit them a few times, run back, hit them some more, etc. They attack with their tail when they're near you.) and collect the medicine.

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: Jump onto one of the four appearing platforms in the water, hit Zoda's Creature a few times, then jump to the next platform or down to dry ground below him to repeat.

evidence.quote: He is in the middle of the water, and there are four platforms that appear and disappear around him. You have to jump on one, hit him a few times, jump to the next platform, and repeat... When you get to the platform below him, you can jump down to dry ground and repeat the process.
